name: Wand of Conducting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Conducting
powers.text: 1 charge: it makes orchestral music. (No other effect in the game.)

text: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as a Magic action: it makes orchestral music. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 the wand crumbles to dust. (No other effect in the game.)
